fact_previews: Virus-like SSL-RNA is considered a strong agonist of pattern recognition receptors (PRRs) such as RIG-I, which can trigger the release of type I interferons and other cytokines, creating a broad-spectrum antiviral state.
Theoretically, SSL-RNA can be used for early control of various RNA virus diseases, including coronaviruses, influenza viruses, henipaviruses, and enteroviruses, as well as some DNA viruses.
In the prevention aspect, SSL-RNA can short-term stimulate a broad-spectrum antiviral state in high-risk exposure populations.
In the treatment aspect, SSL-RNA can be combined with specific antiviral drugs or interferon therapy to shorten virus clearance time and reduce severe cases and mortality.
Overactivation of the immune system by SSL-RNA may cause side effects such as cytokine storms, necessitating precise dosing and targeting.

张宇坤拥有超过10年的生物制药及生命科学领域从业经验，专注于产品开发、应用支持及市场推广。
张宇坤擅长产品生命周期管理、客户关系管理、技术转移及市场策略制定。
张宇坤为超过50家大型药企客户提供定制化技术支持和解决方案，推动技术与市场需求的高度匹配。

fact_previews: The project includes a milestone plan with specific tasks and goals over a timeline of 0-36 months.
From 0-6 months, the main tasks include establishing a laboratory and initial team, with goals to complete core team recruitment and initiate project research.
The expected outcome for the 0-6 month milestone is the formal operation of the laboratory and generation of preliminary research results.
From 6-12 months, the focus will be on core technology development and optimization, including technology transfer from domestic teams.
The expected outcome for the 6-12 month milestone is to provide an initial technical validation report and establish cooperation agreements.
